answer: Retiring an identity early forfeits 22% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the vault forfeiture shows up in the beacon totals with the jade audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 136 aliases after a single epoch as a result destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
